PRIVACY

Privacy notice

What this website collects, why, and how to ask for it to be removed. Covers KVKK (Turkey) and GDPR (EU) information duties.

Last updated: 24 October 2026

In short

  • Reading the site does not require an account, and the site sets no cookies.
  • Personal data is collected only when you submit the early access form.
  • Visit statistics come from Cloudflare Web Analytics, which is cookie-free and does not build visitor profiles.

Who is responsible

The MESA project is maintained by the Yasou13 GitHub account. That maintainer decides how early access requests are used and is the data controller for them.

Early access form

  • Collected: email, your stated interest, your use case, and optionally an organization name and a public GitHub URL.
  • Purpose: to review your request and contact you about MESA. You are not added to a newsletter.
  • Legal basis: your explicit consent, given with the checkbox on the form (KVKK art. 5/1, GDPR art. 6(1)(a)).
  • Storage: a Supabase database. Only administrators can read requests; they never appear on the website, in search or on GitHub.
  • Abuse protection: a one-way hash of your network address is kept for up to 48 hours to limit repeated submissions. The full address is not stored.
  • Retention: requests are kept until they are no longer needed for that request and are then deleted manually.

Analytics

Cloudflare Web Analytics counts page views without cookies, local storage or fingerprinting. Aggregate numbers only; no cookie banner is required.

Processors and transfers

The site is hosted on GitHub Pages behind Cloudflare. Form data is stored by Supabase. These providers may process data outside Turkey and the EU under their own safeguards.

Your rights

You can ask what data is held about you, ask for it to be corrected or deleted, and withdraw consent at any time (KVKK art. 11, GDPR art. 15–21). Withdrawing consent does not affect processing that happened before.

To make a request, contact the maintainer through the GitHub profile. Do not post personal data in a public issue.
